model.name: FastH3 Trim 8-Step — Text to Video (Experimental)
model.description: Official FastVideo FastH3 Trim: an experimental pruned FastH3 with 42 transformer blocks (instead of 50) and rank-16 timestep conditioning, distilled with DMD2 to eight model evaluations and trained with Video Sparse Attention. It generates video with synchronized stereo audio from a text prompt. Image, frame, reference and soundtrack workflows were not distilled, so this entry offers text to video only. Attention is dense by default; SLA is available as an experiment. Released under the MiniMax H3 Community License.
model.selector_help:
FASTH3 TRIM · 8 STEPS · OFFICIAL FASTVIDEO
A single pinned 19 GB INT8 ConvRot checkpoint from FastVideo (Hao AI Lab): an experimental trim with 42 transformer blocks instead of 50 and rank-16 timestep conditioning, distilled to exactly eight evaluations with res_multistep, video shift 10, audio shift 3, and no CFG; the step count is locked. Text to video with native audio only: start/end frames, source video, references and soundtrack-driven generation were not distilled. Dense attention is the default; SLA is an untested experiment for this model. It uses Maestro's own H3 text encoder and VAEs. Not yet benchmarked on a 4090: FastVideo's published speeds come from an RTX 5090. The MiniMax H3 Community License applies; the European Union, United Kingdom, South Korea and United States are excluded territories.
model.inference_steps_help: Fixed at 8: the checkpoint is a DMD2 eight-step distillation.

prompt: A cinematic medium shot of a traveler standing on a windswept overlook at sunrise. The camera arcs around them as their coat moves naturally in the breeze. Distant birds and soft wind are audible, and the traveler says, "We made it."
